style: English indie rock, warm male vocal, electric guitar, bass, drums, 96 BPM, wistful, short song with a clear ending
lyrics:
[Verse]
Streetlights flicker on the long way back
Every window holds a life I lack
I keep the radio low and drive
Just to feel the night alive

[Chorus]
Oh, we were brighter than the dawn
Now the road just carries on
Hold the note and let it fade
This is all the light we made

[Outro]
All the light we made
